_comment: Equity-only OpenBB MCP profile — only equity tools active, discovery disabled for a fixed lean toolset. Copy to ~/.openbb_platform/mcp_settings.json to use.
OPENBB_MCP_DESCRIPTION: OpenBB equity tools only. Access to stock prices, fundamentals, estimates, earnings, ownership, and news.
_note: Discovery is disabled for a minimal, fixed toolset. Use the 'full' profile to enable hot-swapping of tool categories.
